decisions.reason: The existing message-210 MODIFY already reflects the applicable winner eligibility and Chainlink VRF selection in the About-page prize copy; no additional state change is necessary.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already updates the Mission-page prize and randomness copy with the applicable 100-sales-block eligibility and Chainlink VRF selection.

The existing message-210 MODIFY already captures one ticket per referral, selection from the applicable 100-sale block through Chainlink VRF, increased chances from referrals, and automatic drawing at the trigger.
Winner selection and automatic draw execution do not change how fiat buyers access wallets, dashboards, commissions, tickets, or prize proceeds.
The selection method and eligibility rule do not change the existing requirement to notify a prize winner by email when an address was supplied.
The source decision changes winner selection and draw execution, not the $15 primary-sale allocation established earlier.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already contains the applicable hero and mechanics-preview changes; the detailed VRF winner-selection rule does not require another hero-state update.
Automatic execution of the drawing is distinct from prize collection and payment; the candidate already requires automatic wallet transfer and remains valid unchanged.
The $5 coded-referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, and automatic payment behavior are unaffected by the prize winner-selection decision.
The message-210 counter requirement is already represented, and changing winner selection or automatic draw execution does not alter the counter text or its required state.
The source decision does not change the secondary royalty amount, founder allocation, pool funding behavior, or rule that secondary sales do not generate referral tickets.
Selection of a Small Block prize winner does not modify allocation of the $5 commission for a mint without a referral code.
